summary: Today's briefing highlights key legal developments and significant retail trends impacting the Indian market, alongside notable corporate leadership changes.

bullets.text: Justice T. Vinod Kumar has been transferred to the Telangana High Court, following a Collegium recommendation in September 2026.
RPSG Group appointed Harshad Jain as CEO of its FMCG business, marking a significant leadership change in the retail sector.
SLN Coffee plans to invest approximately Rs 2,500 crore over the next ten years, targeting Rs 1,500 crore revenue next fiscal.
India's opposition parties are protesting voter list revisions, claiming they favor Prime Minister Modi's party, escalating tensions ahead of elections.
Musk has vowed to provide affordable Starlink services in India, intensifying competition with Ambani's Jio ahead of its IPO.
